title: An old bookmark to the Catalog page opens the Part Library
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • {Address-A} is the address of the Catalog page from before the Part Lifecycle build was deployed (for example your ShopView address followed by /parts/parts-catalogue), saved as a bookmark or written down.
custom_steps:
1. Open {Address-A} with the bookmark, or paste it into the address bar and press Enter.
  2. Read the page title.
  3. Read the address in the browser's address bar.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: The page opens without an error or a "page not found" message.
  • Step 2: The page title reads "Part Library".
  • Step 3: The address is still {Address-A}: the page's address has not changed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S12-N2, S12-R2, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 7.1 (Part Library), board 7.0 (Before: the Catalog page today), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-N2: “The address of the Part Library page stays the same, so bookmarks and saved links still open it.”
  • S12-R2: “The page title on that screen reads "Part Library".”
  • SV-10825 acceptance criteria: “Given a bookmark to the old Catalog page, when it is opened, then the Part Library opens.”
